page.layout: One page of text. Heading "AD LECTOREM." at full width at the top. Below it, a verse dedication in lines with a woodcut initial Q at the left, followed by a centred author line in small capitals. At the foot, a signature mark "* 2" at left and the catchword "IN-" at right. No margin notes.

main_text.head: AD LECTOREM.
main_text.p: [Q]uid[?] cupis exactè cognoscere Jura Duelli En liber est voto commodus hicce tuo,
In quo perdoctâ methodo præcepta docentur Quę poteris facili discere lector ope:
Hæc præcepta vetant ad vulnera sur-gere cives, Prętorii fasces quos cohibere solent:
Hæc præcepta jubent decidi à Judice lites, Non pugnâ dirimi, quas malus er-ror alit:
Hæc præcepta monent justo modera-mine vitam Et bona tutari quemque decere sua,
Et simul emendant condignè legibus illos Omnes, injustè qui prius arma movent.

page.notes:
The library stamp ("BIBLIOTECA NAZ..." with a second line below) overlaps the first lines and is left out. The first word "Quid" is partly hidden by the stamp and the woodcut initial, so it is marked [?]. The initial Q is a woodcut. The line "Jura Duelli" is printed with J, which is kept as J. The line-end hyphens in "sur-gere", "er-ror" and "modera-mine" are printed hyphens. The author line is in small capitals and is set as a
